2607.28990.title: Scaling Scientific Discovery Environments for Turn-Level Agentic RL
2607.28990.paper_summary: Large language model agents have shown promising capabilities in data-driven scientific discovery tasks, where an agent interacts with an execution environment and produces a statistical claim. Long-horizon scientific analysis remains constrained by the lack of process supervised environments over real-world scientific data. This paper introduces SciDisco, a scalable framework for training Scientific Discovery agents in process-verifiable environments. SciThèque compiles hypotheses, datasets, hidden evidence graphs, and verifiers into task environments where analytical progress can be checked during interaction. DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis uses these environments to construct verifier-filtered multi-turn demonstrations. DiscoPO then uses the environment as the source of training signal, assigning turn-level credit to actions that produce verifiable analytical evidence. Experiments show that SciDisco-14B reaches state-of-the-art on hypothesis-driven scientific data analysis benchmarks.
2607.28990.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在數據驅動的科學發現任務中顯示出有希望的能力，代理與執行環境互動並產生統計主張。長期的科學分析仍然受到缺乏對現實世界科學數據進行過程監督環境的限制。本文介紹了SciDisco，一個可擴展的框架，用於在過程可驗證的環境中訓練科學發現代理。SciThèque將假設、數據集、隱藏證據圖和驗證者編譯成任務環境，在這些環境中可以在互動過程中檢查分析進展。基於DAG的軌跡合成使用這些環境來構建經過驗證者過濾的多輪演示。然後，DiscoPO將環境用作訓練信號的來源，為產生可驗證分析證據的行動分配回合級別的信譽。實驗顯示，SciDisco-14B在以假設驅動的科學數據分析基準上達到了最先進的水平。
